notes: The colophon names no scribe, commissioner, owner or patron. The era isn't stated in the text. Reading the year as VS fits the catalogue field and the Nepali wording ('sāla miti ... roja'). VS 1939 Jyeṣṭha śukla 6 falls around 23 May 1882, which was a Tuesday, so it agrees with 'roja 3'. After the date the scribe added two corrupt subhāṣita stanzas ('dhanyās te vītarāgāḥ ...'), of the kind attributed to Bhartṛhari's śatakas. Neither stanza contains a personal name. 'vighnaṃ vināsanāye namaḥ' is an invocation.
